name: Schwung
description: Runs Schwung modules (the module ecosystem of Ableton Move) on Push 3. Each Schwung track is one signal chain (up to 8 MIDI FX, one instrument, up to 8 audio FX) on its own Live track: the Live track sends MIDI to port Schwung on the channel of the Schwung track, and hears it back on the Link Audio channel Schwung N. Needs push-audio-loopback for audio, and push-manager and push-display for the Push screen.
author: rgeissen
